name: IKENIE 2
source:
Men are distorted in madness, while women are distorted in pain.

Main character is a NEET hanging around an adult web site. He sends out emails pretending to be a computer profane medical student inviting girls to meet in real life. He receives a response from milky84 and they start exchanging emails. One day she sends a letter saying "Hey... do you want to torture women?"

[Edited from [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-august-2000-tsukihime.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
男人因疯狂而扭曲，女人因痛苦而扭曲。

主人公是一名沉迷成人网站的家里蹲。他假扮电脑高材生和医学生，发邮件邀请女性线下见面。他收到网名“milky84”的回复，两人开始互发邮件。某天，对方寄来一封信：“嘿……你想折磨女人吗？”

[改编自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-august-2000-tsukihime.html]vndbreview[/url]]
